description: This file contains the EntityCrypto utility class for handling encryption and decryption of entity data within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages cryptographic keys, supports different encryption methods, and interacts with key storage mechanisms, including legacy and modern approaches. The class provides methods for encrypting and decrypting objects using various algorithms, handling key generation, and key management with thread safety.

classes.name: EntityCrypto
classes.description: Final utility class providing cryptographic methods for encrypting and decrypting entity data, managing keys, and handling various cryptographic algorithms within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: clearKeyCache
methods.description: Clears the internal cache of cryptographic keys.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts an object into a hex-encoded string using specified key and encryption method.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a hex-encoded string back into an object, handling different encryption algorithms and backward compatibility.

methods.name: doDecrypt
methods.description: Internal method to perform decryption with a specified handler and algorithm, converting the decrypted bytes into an object.

methods.name: findKey
methods.description: Retrieves cryptographic key bytes from the key store, loading from the database if not cached.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key, encodes it, and stores it in the database under a hashed key name.
